decisions.reason: The client replaces the freelancer-delivered flipbook with a final PDF delivered to the client for client-managed Heyzine upload, so the previous deliverable key is obsolete.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
You're welcome!

There is no extra text, only those images. I also obtained the white label for heyzine, so send me the final PDF and ill upload it to my account. Thanks

decisions.reason: Selecting Heyzine and assigning upload responsibility to the client does not change the required two-page spread compatibility, balance, or page-count rule.
The platform configuration decision does not alter article whitespace rules; the separate image-only instruction in the same message is already represented by the candidate's existing MODIFY.
Heyzine white-label branding concerns platform chrome and does not change the magazine layout's polished, modern, site-aligned visual style.
The platform, white-label, and upload decisions do not change author names, photographs, sizing, sourcing, or placement.
Client responsibility for uploading the PDF is unrelated to the designer's responsibility for placing cover-listed articles.
White-label platform configuration does not alter article category requirements or label presentation.
The Heyzine and upload decisions do not affect future word-count guidance for avoiding whitespace.
The selected flipbook platform and white-label tier do not change the requirement that advertisements render sharply.
The platform and upload configuration does not change the approved Inter typeface, weight, or readability constraint.
Client-managed Heyzine upload does not change the requirement for accurate article page numbers on the cover.
The platform configuration and upload handoff do not alter table-of-contents completion timing or pagination accuracy.
